text:
Dylan Cozens has had a hard few weeks. He's pointless in four with the chances thinning out, and Ottawa has just 47% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, eight points worse than without him. Early in the month he was also in the headlines for a hit on AJ Greer that put the Ducks forward on injured reserve.

That's an odd look for a player Evolving-Hockey had 53rd of 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, with most of his value at the defensive end (98th percentile for taking chances away). The Senators have moved Tim Stützle onto his line since William Eklund went down, so there's every chance the five-on-five numbers turn as the line settles.

He's 25, with 110 career goals coming in, and a transition player by Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking (53% of his shots off the rush). Our range: 18 to 31 goals.
